# DropSpace 1.1 Beta3

<!-- update-summary: Improves bilingual song lookup, compares more lyric candidates within each source, ranks usable timing and duration evidence, and temporarily backs off failing lyric endpoints while preserving recording identity and source preferences. -->

## Changes

- English and Chinese Jay Chou song names can share an explicit, bounded lookup mapping. The bundled table contains 153 song-title pairs recovered from the local Dynamic Notch 2.0.3 (176) package. Search preserves original metadata and fallback queries. Accepting a cross-language result still requires the mapped artist, independent duration evidence and compatible recording credits.
- Online sources compare up to six admitted candidates in the current result pool instead of stopping at the first usable lyric. The first usable result can still appear progressively while the existing short selection budget runs. Search stays bounded to three terms and the existing source preferences.
- Candidate selection considers usable word timing, duration closeness and timed-line coverage after recording identity, target-language requirements and source priority. Invalid or overlapping timing cannot gain priority by adding more timestamps.
- LRCLIB continues from an unusable exact result into bounded search. Duplicate or already-attempted rows do not consume its candidate slots.
- Failing search and lyric endpoints receive bounded temporary backoff. Manual refresh can retry transient failures; server rate-limit cooldowns remain respected. Normal empty results and caller cancellation do not count as endpoint failures.

v1.1.0-beta.2 is the immediate upgrade baseline for this release. Existing settings, content, source choices, model files and independent CUDA component bytes are preserved. Optional AI translation remains opt-in, and a valid native translation still takes precedence.

## Downloads and validation

Windows x64 build 20348 or later. Choose `DropSpaceSetup.exe`, the portable `DropSpace.exe`, or the MSIX package. Stable remains 1.0. Existing Beta users receive this version through the Beta update channel; portable updates use manual replacement.

Focused matching, provider, transport and integration checks, a real public-catalogue query and isolated native-window interaction are recorded in the [validation record](../../docs/dev/1.1-beta3-lyrics-matching.md). Publication reuses that evidence and adds source-bound Windows packaging, one isolated installer-payload check and public download/update verification. Three legacy test fixtures also fail on unchanged Beta2; they are recorded separately from the passing focused cases.

The input DMG contains compiled native Swift code and configuration, not the author's complete Swift project. DropSpace uses the extracted factual title mappings and independently implemented C# adaptations of the verified mechanisms. No private backend credential or vendor-only service is included.

The pre-existing background native heap crash (`0xc0000374`) has not been proven fixed. This matching update does not claim long-term native stability or coverage of every catalog, player and network condition.
